notes.title: Civilization meets Gladiator in Roman strategy game that finally hits 1.0 today
notes.content:
I think about the Roman Empire every day. I know it's a meme, but it's true for me. That meme is my hole, it was made for me etc. I've trekked along Hadrian's Wall, toured the Colosseum in Rome, and beamed every Roman movie I can find into my eyeballs-even the travesty of historical inaccuracies that is Gladiator 2. But I've always wondered why we don't have more Roman video games. Rise: Son of Rome was ok, but the era has largely been bypassed by mainstream studios. That's why I'm glad that Roman 4X game Yield! Fall of Rome has finally exited early access and hit 1.0.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
New historical 4X game Yield Fall of Rome is like a faster Civilization 6

notes.title: Yield! 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Citizens, warriors, and monarchs, [/h3][p][/p][p]the day has come. After countless battles fought during Early Access, [i]Yield![/i] marches proudly into its [b]1.0 Full Release[/b].[/p][p]This is more than just the “end” of Early Access - it’s the beginning of a new era for [i]Yield![/i] We've re-forged core systems, introduced a massive array of new skills and abilities, and refined the balance of the battlefield to make every decision count. Your monarch now grows with you, your units march under a clearer banner of progression, and your enemies are craftier than ever.[/p][p]We’ve listened to your feedback, pored over battle reports, and hammered away at the game’s foundation to deliver the most complete, strategic, and replayable version of [i]Yield![/i] yet. Whether you’re returning from the front lines or stepping onto the field for the first time, this update ensures no two campaigns will ever feel the same.[/p][p]So rally your armies, sharpen your strategies, and claim your place in history. Rome may be falling - but your empire is just beginning.[/p][p]
[i]Note: Due to the new XP and skill systems, saves from older (Vanilla) versions may not be fully compatible. If you’re coming from an earlier Early Access build, we recommend restarting your current mission (not the entire campaign) before continuing your conquest.[/i]


[/p][previewyoutube="uQRH_D4-vDI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]


[b]Patch Notes – 1.0 Full Release[/b][/p][p][b]System Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Veterancy Rework[/b] – Fully experience-based with clearer gain indicators. See exactly how much your unit needs to level up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status Effects Overhaul[/b] – Lingering effects now display in the unit info panel alongside buffs from terrain or auras.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monarch Level System Rebuilt[/b] – Monarchs now start at Level 1 and can reach Level 10, with a unique progression curve and [i]manual[/i] specialization choices for endless replay variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Campaign Monarch Progression[/b] – Monarch experience is now permanent for the entire campaign. Resurrected monarchs retain their last level.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Veterancy Completion[/b] – Units missing upgrades now have full skill paths (e.g., Battle Ram, Settler, Trader).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faction & Unit Rebalance[/b] – Horse Scouts and Peasant Militia adjusted for better faction identity. Battle Ram durability reduced but given new growth upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI / UX / VFX[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Particle System[/b] – Level-ups, healing, and abilities now have individual visual effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faction Preview Panels[/b] – Updated with clearer faction identities and monarch info.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monarch Skill Tree[/b] – Fully navigable, with previews of future skills and enemy monarch abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Active Ability Visualization[/b] – Abilities now appear centered over units for clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tutorial[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated and expanded to cover new systems and mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Attributes, Skills & Abilities[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Clear Categorization[/b] – All upgrades are now explicitly Attributes, Skills, or Abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]+49 New Passive Skills[/b] – From [i]Vampirism[/i] to [i]Emperor Shield[/i], drastically expanding unit customization.[/p][/*][*][p][b]+24 New Activated Abilities[/b] – Including [i]Spear Throw[/i], [i]Blood Ritual[/i], and [i]Relentless Assault[/i].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Yield! 1.0 is up ahead!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Heyho everyone,[/b][/h3][p]It’s been a long road since we first opened the gates to YIELD! in Early Access - and you’ve been right there with us every step of the way. Through your feedback, suggestions, bug reports, wild ideas, and the occasional “Wait, what if…?” moment, you’ve helped shape the game into something far bigger than when we started.[/p][p]For months, you’ve been asking the big question: When’s 1.0?

[previewyoutube=Dqq8Ywd7V3U;full][/previewyoutube]

Well, it’s time to stop wondering. [u][b]YIELD! 1.0 launches on the 11th of August![/b][/u] [/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]What’s New in 1.0?[/b][/h3][p]One of the loudest requests since day one has been more faction variety and a bigger, bolder role for Monarchs. We heard you - and we’ve gone all in.[/p][list][*][p]Monarch Overhaul - Kings and Queens now have expanded Skills, Attributes, and Abilities that can change the flow of battle.
[/p][/*][*][p]Persistent Progress - Monarch experience now carries over across your whole campaign (up to level 10), even if they fall in battle.
[/p][/*][*][p]Unique Monarch Playstyles - Each Monarch now comes with distinct advantages, giving their armies a completely different edge.
[/p][/*][*][p]Revival With Honor - If your Monarch is defeated, they return with their full experience intact.
[/p][/*][*][p]New Buildings & Balancing - Fresh city structures, refined balancing, and quality-of-life tweaks across the board.

[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s just the highlight reel - this update is stacked.
[/p][h3][b]Why This Matters[/b][/h3][p]Version 1.0 isn’t the [i]end[/i] of YIELD! - it’s the start of something new. With this foundation in place, we’ll keep building, tweaking, and adding more ways to conquer, scheme, and outwit your foes.[/p][p]You’ve helped us get here. Now we can’t wait to see what you do with it.[/p][p]Let’s make history together.
[/p][p]Billionworlds & Daedalic Entertainment[/p]

notes.title: Challenges of Gods Update
notes.content:
Heyho everyone,

after some final tinkering and finetuning we can present today our newest Update for Yield! Fall of Rome - the Challenges of Gods Update!

Not just a new game mode and bug fixes await you after downloading the update, but for the majority of you the performance should be significantly enhanced, as well - but to not hold back any further information - here are the patch notes:

[h3]New Game Mode: Challenges[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brand new Gamemode available for everyone: The Challenges of Gods
[*] 10 unique challenges
[*] Hard Mode for those looking to be truly tested
[*] 18 new achievements (+2 hidden ones 🤫)
[*] Compete for speed in the new challenge highscore leaderboard
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
Large overhaul of the game’s UI issues which caused noticeable fps drops when being
updated, as well as AI’s turn duration. This should make the game feel significantly smoother
to play and jump right into, and cut down on the frustration of arbitrary waiting.


[h3]UI & Map[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved general performance of all hexes in the game
[*] Improved performance when selecting hexes
[*] Improved performance when building improvements
[*] Improved performance when opening cities
[*] Improved performance in Policy Screen
[*] Reduced loading time into a game by ~20% (better on lower-end PCs)
[*] Improved performance when increasing settlement level
[/list]

[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved performance with large amounts of units on the map
[*] Drastically reduced AI turn duration (~8x faster)
○ [i]We managed to cut the wait-time for AI’s moves when the player doesn’t see nor has the information of their moves. The turn duration therefore remains approximately the same when you can see their moves. We’ve therefore also added the option to quicken or completely skip AI animation under animation and camera settings in the “Gameplay” section of Settings[/i]
[*] Gameplay Improvements
[*] Unit’s path is instantly visible when giving orders
[*] Right-clicking a city with a selected unit will now open the city screen if the current
[*] unit cannot reach the city this turn, or has used its movement
[*] Added screenshake effects and controller vibration when building improvements
[*] Added additional haptic feedback in controllers when building units and buildings in
[*] settlements
[*] Policy screen no longer closes immediately after enacting a policy
[*] Milestone Reached pop-up policy choice now has a back button and no longer needs
[*] to be made immediately
[*] Moved various camera settings under a “Advanced Settings” sub-tab
[*] Reworked Relationship panel on the right side of the screen
○ [i]You can now see crowns owned by all factions in all single player gamemodes[/i]
○ [i]You can see relationship between the present factions by hovering over their portrait on the right side of the screen[/i]
○ [i]Added visual indication of which kings are currently alive[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed animation bug when a ranged unit attacked a unit with first strike (like the
[*] Bulgarian Footman)
[*] Fixed a softlock that occurred when a Settlement would level-up because of another
[*] player’s trade
[*] Fixed occasional visual flicker when navigating main menus with keyboard or
[*] controller
[/list]

notes.title: Campaign of the Week #11 is out!
notes.content:
Heyho everyone, 

This week we have another faction celebrating their debut in our campaign of the week:
Follow Attila the Hun into Battle!

No glory is greater than richness. No honor worth more than a dozen
crates packed with golden Roman trinkets and an ocean of solidi. Maintaining such
an army would require fortunes not seen by man, and the Hunnic general had a very
large army. A treaty’s worth to the Huns was measured only by the gold it brought –
until it was broken in favor of an even richer one.

[i]"Mighty ruler of the Huns, I bring news from the West! A scented letter, a
diamond ring and a proposal were brought back by the imperial messenger. Those
leather-shoed pigs first suggest a marriage, then refuse your right to their empire.
Good I say, the riders were starting to get bored of the peace. Should they not listen
to reason, we’ll take it ourselves."[/i]

notes.title: Campaign of the Week #8 is out!
notes.content:
Heyho everyone, 

Today we have another leader and his followership celebrating their debut - follow Abu Bakr and his Arabic empire into their first campaign of the week!

Following the death of the last Prophet, the Arabic Empire shattered into
disarray. False prophets roam the alleys of Medina, and opposing religions seep into
the minds of its people. Surrounding provinces refuse to pay their due zakat,
claiming their debt was to the Prophet, not his successor. People needed a common
goal in order to unite under one leader, and as such the religious conquest began.
[i]
"Khalifat Rasul Allah, the successor of the Prophet and the first Caliph. There is
no compulsion in religion, yet unity through Islam must take precedence. Wise you
are, Al-Saddiq, your truth shall bring the light of Islam to our enemies’ eyes, or
render them blind should they resist it."[/i]

notes.title: Campaign of the Week #7 is out!
notes.content:
Heyho everyone, 

Today we have a special treat - follow Charlemagne and his Frankish empire into their first campaign of the week!

Lessons learned, failures studied, the Frankish empire has grown prosperous in times of the Roman crisis. What goes up, must come down, and as such, a vacuum of power and leadership has emerged of preposterous dimensions, one that someone eventually had to fill.
[i]
"Where the Roman Empire has failed, the Frankish one shall flourish. Where
the Roman Legions have faltered, our battalions shall triumph. And when their
legacy has fully dwindled, our people shall thrive in the light of our holy empire. The
world must be united under one border. Under one god. Under one holy emperor."[/i]

notes.title: Campaign of the Week #5 is out!
notes.content:
Heyho everyone,

Today we have another new campaign of the week - this time following Kavad and his Persian Empire.

The people of your empire are scattered. Nomadic and without purpose, they’re
unable to uphold the old accords. Tensions rise, oaths are on the verge of breaking and thus
decisive retaliation shall be the only remedy:

"Shahanshah, King of Kings, the time of peace is at an end. Ignoring your decree, our
neighbors have become vultures - the fools grew bold enough to forget that only by your
good grace these dunes of sand have yet not swallowed them whole. Mount up the Savaran,
show them why you are the undisputed King of the deserts!"

notes.title: Campaign of the Week #4 is out!
notes.content:
To all conquerers,

There is a [b]brandnew Campaign of the Week[/b] waiting for you!

In this campaign, you play as [b]the Berbers[/b] led by [b]Queen Dihya[/b].

The southern borders of the empire weaken, and Arabic warbands are pushing ever forward to embolden their dynasty, aspiring to become high rulers of Africa.
Outright open war between the two southern empires seems inevitable and is only delayed by remnants of Roman forces, cowering in crumbling strongholds they’ve seized during the long gone zenith of their power. 
Should you hurry, you could be the one to bring them salvation from the Arab forces, or reclaim what was never theirs, and prepare for the oncoming carnage.

Prepare to fight your toughest battle yet!

notes.title: Release Day is here!
notes.content:
Heyho everyone,

It is finally time to release Yield! Fall of Rome into its Early Access period - and we couldn’t be more excited!

Yield! Fall of Rome combines the deep flexibility and strategic options known from the 4X genre and distills the experience into dynamic gameplay making it perfectly fit into the (sometimes short on time) lifestyle of the present days.

Forge your Kingdom amidst the Ruins of Rome in this turn-based strategy game! As the world crumbles, rebuild civilization and shape your people’s destiny. Unleash your strategic prowess, conquer provinces, and crush all who stand in your way.

notes.title: New historical 4X game Yield Fall of Rome is like a faster Civilization 6
notes.content:
I love finding, playing, and sharing videogames that involve ancient history. Whether it's sailing the seas of the Aegean in Assassin's Creed Odyssey, making tactical decisions in Total War, or even getting to know the Greek gods in Hades, there are a lot of ways to explore reinterpretations of the past. Today, another contender joins the fold. Yield! Fall of Rome combines quick thinking and strategy on a scale that rivals even Civilization, and it's available on Steam now.

notes.title: Big Update: Improved visuals, UI and audio!
notes.content:
[list]
Visual:
[*] New outside-of-map visuals
[*] New clouds and fog
[*] More visual variation to the terrain
[*] Adjusted scaling of Improvements and replaced models for some of them
[*] Improved movement animations for Units

UI:
[*] New UI for building Improvements, now in the context of the hex where you build
[*] New UI for Settlement info

Audio:
[*] New sound effects
[*] Dynamic ambience related to the where you are on the map

Changes:
[*] No longer wrapping of maps in the Campaigns

Fixes:
[*] Optimized interaction with Units, Settlements and Improvements
[*] Better tactical decisions by the AI
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Turn-Based Thursday Fest Update: Introductory Campaign
notes.content:
We celebrate our participation in the Turn-Based Thursday Fest!

Now you can choose between Introductory Campaign and Campaign of the Week:

[list]
[*] Introductory Campaign is a fixed Campaign designed for new players, and allows you to play as much as you want.
[*] Campaign of the Week is generated once per week, and can only be played through once. This is for those who wants to compete for highscore!
[/list]

notes.title: Huge Update: Play the Campaign in a whole new way!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved graphics
[*] Campaign overhauled
[*] New Policy system
[*] New Trade system
[*] Religion
[*] Foreign Relations
[*] The Romans as a special faction
[*] And much more!
[/list]

notes.title: Naval Update: New Ships and coastal Improvements
notes.content:

[*] New land Improvements: Workshop, Toll Station and Castle

[/list]

notes.title: Big Update: New Technology tree!
notes.content:
[list]

notes.title: Weekly Update: New UI for the city screen
notes.content:
- City screen UI reworked for better overview and ease of use
- Minor bug fixes

notes.content:

notes.title: Weekly Update: Hamlets and new Buildings
notes.content:
- Added the Hamlet, a new Improvement that can be built adjacent to the City Center without any resource requirements
- Added four new Buildings: Tax Office, Library, National Manor and National Treasury
- Improved the Kingdom selection screen
- Cities can now grow to level IV
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Weekly Update: In-game UI and controls
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Unit icons, Resource icons and in-game panels are now in line with new look
[*] You can now use right click to move and middle click to pan (option in settings)
[*] More information on Specialists and pop-up when leveling them up
[*] Fixed stuttering when showing replays of enemy moves
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Big update for the UI and the Campaign!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Completely new UI for menues
[*] Big changes to the Policy system
[*] Gain Specialists to boost your Kingdom
[*] New campaign screens to make it easier to understand
[*] More settings
[*] Some Hotkeys
[*] Mouse over / hover on elements
[*] Easy AI is now quite a bit easier
[*] Tons of fixes

notes.title: New kingdoms and a new look!
notes.content:
For over 2 years we have only had the Britons available, now we have 7 more kingdoms to choose from! From the Persians in the east, the Berbers in the south west, to The Huns from the north east, and many more, there is a much larger diversity to play with. 

As a icing on the cake, there is also a very big graphical update in this demo, including a new UI.

Hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: BIG Campaign update!
notes.content: Campaign of the Week has a new format, with different types of Population unlocking new Policies across the Provinces you capture. Build up your Kingdom for the struggles that awaits you!

notes.title: Campaign of the Week - win a copy of the game!
notes.content:
Contgratulations to "Oposing" who won last weeks campaign! Impressive score!

A new Campaign of the Week started today and will run until next Wednesday. This time the top 3 performers will win a copy of the game! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/kxDYk6Nxn5]Discord[/url] server to claim your price.

In addition, we released a new update for the game in the time for the new Campaign of the Week: Lots of new types of goody huts! This will give you more interesting choices in the early game, hope you enjoy it!
